title: Kissed Mustardy Red Chilli Cheese-Pull Pilaf
description: An indulgent Saudi-Arabian dish featuring red chilli and cheese-pulling technique, ideal for a light lunch or dinner. This recipe is tailored to be low FODMAP-friendly.

ingredients.name: Pinch of red chili flakes (adjustable for heat preference)

instructions: In a saucepan, combine quinoa with 2 cups water and bring to boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until liquid is absorbed (about 15 min).
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add onion and sauté until translucent (about 4 min). Add garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in Dijon mustard, coconut milk, salt, pepper, and red chili flakes. Bring to a simmer and let it reduce slightly (about 5 min).
Fold in cooked quinoa and the grated Parmesan cheese. Serve hot as a side dish or main course. Adjust seasoning with more salt if needed.
For a spicy kick, stir in sliced jalapeño peppers before serving.
